name: The Ace Attorney’s Masked Secret
overview: Six years after a masked ball changes their lives forever, lawyer Madeline crosses paths with billionaire heir Nicholas once again. What he doesn't know is that she's been raising their gifted daughter alone—while another woman has stolen her place. As old feelings return, so do the lies that tore them apart. The only thing harder to hide than the truth… may be the little girl who looks just like him.
